body:
## Kurta sets that feel like home

Finding a well-made Indian kurta set in the USA usually means a long drive to a local store or a gamble on a marketplace. Bahe Kurtiz makes kurta sets in our own Jaipur unit and ships them straight to you – from New Jersey and Texas to California.

## What you will find

- **Hand block print kurta sets** – soft cotton, printed by hand with wooden blocks
- **Embroidered kurta sets** – cotton and cotton flex with thread embroidery and organza dupattas
- **3-piece sets** with kurta, pants and dupatta, ready for puja, office or a family dinner

## Why women in the USA choose made-to-measure

US sizes and Indian sizes rarely match. That is why every set can be stitched to your measurements – no tailor visit, no alterations.

## Shipping, fit and returns

- **Free worldwide shipping** to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia, with tracking
- Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days; made-to-measure pieces take 5–7 working days, then 5–10 business days for delivery
- **Free custom fit** – send your bust, waist, hip and height and we stitch it for you
- We send you photos of your piece before it ships
- Import duties and taxes included – nothing to pay on delivery

Not sure which set to pick? [WhatsApp us](https://wa.me/917073350886) and a real person from our Jaipur team will help.

faq.q: Do you ship kurta sets to all US states?
faq.a: Yes, we ship to every US state with tracking, and shipping is free.
Ready sizes ship in 2–4 working days and made-to-measure pieces in 5–7 working days. Express delivery then takes about 5–10 business days to the USA, UK, Canada, UAE and Australia.

faq.q: What if I am between sizes?
faq.a: Use the Fit Finder on any product page, or send us your bust, waist, hip and height on WhatsApp and we will stitch the piece to your measurements at no extra cost.

Shipping is free. No. Import duties and taxes are included – we ship duties-paid, so there is nothing extra to pay on delivery. Many small orders are not charged, but it depends on your country's rules.
